size.evidence: network_game_invalidate clears 0x434 bytes; network_game_settings_updated copies 0x434-byte settings messages; network_game_server_start_network_game copies 0x434 bytes from game+0x08

fields.name: map_name
fields.evidence: network_game_server_change_map_name copies up to 0x7f characters at game+0x2c after the leading field; network_game_create_game_objects passes game+0x24 to csstrncpy as the multiplayer map name

fields.name: game_variant
fields.evidence: network_game_create_game_objects passes game+0xa4 to game_set_game_variant as an existing 0x68-byte game_variant_t

fields.name: field_10d
fields.evidence: network_game_invalidate initializes byte +0x10d to 2; no direct semantic read of this serialized game-data byte is proven

fields.name: maximum_player_count
fields.evidence: network_game_add_player compares signed byte +0x10e against the current player count; network_game_invalidate initializes it to 16

fields.name: field_10f
fields.evidence: network_game_invalidate clears this byte and network settings serialization includes the surrounding setup-byte region; no direct semantic read is proven

fields.name: difficulty
fields.evidence: network_game_create_game_objects assigns signed 16-bit game+0x110 to game_options_t.difficulty

fields.name: machine_count
fields.evidence: network_game_add_machine/remove_machine increment/decrement word +0x112; settings validation and logs call it machine count

fields.name: machines
fields.evidence: network_game_add_machine and network_game_update_machine copy four 0x44-byte records beginning at +0x114

fields.name: player_count
fields.evidence: network_game_add_player/remove_player increment/decrement word +0x224; settings validation and logs call it player count

fields.name: players
fields.evidence: network_game_add_player, remove_player, and invalidate iterate sixteen 0x20-byte records beginning at +0x226

fields.name: random_seed
fields.evidence: network_game_set_random_seed and network_game_get_number_of_games_played read/write game+0x428; game_create_game_objects passes it as game_options_t.random_seed

fields.name: number_of_games_played
fields.evidence: network_game_set_number_of_games_played writes game+0x42c and network_game_server logs it as number_of_games_played

fields.name: map_loaded
fields.evidence: network_game_invalidate/reset clear byte +0x430; network_game_end_and_load_ui tests it as the loaded-game flag

notes: The artifact records the proven subranges and array strides; unobserved bytes between fields are intentionally omitted and remain padding in the rendered type.
The machine and player array entries are represented by network_machine_record_t and network_player_record_t.
